name: Durban Poison (3.5g) - Classic Cuts
description:
Private Stock is now Classic Cuts - A selection of classic and modern classic varieties curated from a lineage of tried and true genetics. Always hand-trimmed, always grown indoors. Available in 3.5g & select 1g strains. 

_____

This pure sativa originates from the South African port city of Durban. It has gained popularity worldwide for its sweet smell and energetic, uplifting effects. Durban Poison is the perfect strain to help you stay productive through a busy day, when exploring the outdoors, or to lend a spark of creativity. Growers and concentrate enthusiasts will both enjoy the over-sized resin glands which make this strain a quality choice for concentrate extraction. The buds are round and chunky, and leave a thick coating of trichomes on almost all areas of the plant.

name: The Judge (3.5g) - Gold Cuts

name: 3C | Sasquatch Sap | 8th
description:
GENETICS: Chem Sister x Choco Diesel x Sour Dub (Gorilla Glue #4)
ORIGIN: Craeted by 3C Farms
AROMA: Sweet, Gas, Piney
EFFECT: Creative, Relaxing, Well-Rounded
TERPENES: 
β-Caryophyllene: anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. Relieve anxiety and pain, reduce cholesterol, prevent Osteoporosis, and treat seizures.
δ-Limonene: boost mood, relieve stress, create sense of euphoria. Antifungal and antibacterial properties. May help relieve heartburn and gastric reflux.
α-Humulene: relaxing, boosts creativity, relieves pain, and calms the mind

DESCRIPTION: A robust and well rounded strain that inspires creativity with a deeply comforting body high, Sasquatch Sap is a fan favorite and one of our best sellers. The genetic lineage of Chem Sister x Choco Diesel x Sour Dub manifests into an incredibly sticky, resinous coat of trichomes that layers on top of luminescent lime green buds. The scent and taste is sweet at first before it quickly bursts into the quintessential diesel notes we love and search for in cannabis cultivars.
Note: THC% may vary batch to batch.

description:
GENETICS: OG Kush
ORIGIN: Bryan’s Personal Original 1996 OG Cut
AROMA: Piney, Gas, Skunky
EFFECT: Well-Rounded, Euphoric, Cerebral
TERPENES: 
β-Caryophyllene: anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. Relieve anxiety and pain, reduce cholesterol, prevent Osteoporosis, and treat seizures.
β-Myrcene: improve sleep, reduce pain, promote relaxation, enhance mood, relieve anxiety, relieve stress, strengthen the immune system.
δ-Limonene: boost mood, relieve stress, create sense of euphoria. Antifungal and antibacterial properties. May help relieve heartburn and gastric reflux.

DESCRIPTION: The original OG Kush’s story is shrouded in mystery, just like the Illuminati… Our part of the story comes into play in the late 90’s when we were gifted an original cut of the OG Kush. The iconic skunk, gas and pine aromas and flavors have kept this strain as a staple in our strain library ever since. Its triangle shaped buds have orange red hairs bursting through the bright green nodules giving it the quintessential look of top shelf cannabis. Its well rounded effects provide users with a cerebral and euphoric head high that is mirrored by a comforting, almost couch locked body high.

CONSPIRACY: The Illuminati are suspected by many to be plotting the creation of a New World Order, a singular, all-powerful world government. Many populists, such as members of the John Birch Society believe that some collegiate fraternities, such as the Skull and Bones of Yale, gentlemen's clubs, such as the Bohemian Club, and think tanks such as the Council on Foreign Relations and the Trilateral Commission, are just front organizations of the Illuminati. 
Note: THC% may vary batch to batch.

name: Crescendo | Big Buds | 3.5g
description: Crescendo is a Sativa-dominant cultivar that lives up to its soaring name. THC Design’s unique pheno of Crescendo comes from the winning seed of a batch bred by Ethos Genetics from Denver, Colorado. Featuring the combined powers of a Chem Dawg strain, I-95 strain, and Mandarin Cookies cross, Crescendo has a very mellow and smooth smoke. The flavor comes straight from its Chem Dawg heritage, with a strong taste of diesel and earth, and a hint of citrus. The average THC level of 30-35% sounds heavier than it hits: the strong Sativa lean makes this a suitable morning or daytime smoke. The cerebral effect is pronounced, with a hazy and uplifting trip into the clouds that is mentally active, but not overly intoxicating. Physical Effects : A serene and pleasant body high that is not sedating. This is an appealing strain for managing symptoms of stress, depression, and fatigue. Flavor : Earthy, spicy pine with a bright lemon-lime finish.
